# Quiet UI (`visual-architecture-system`) v6.2

> Open-source design system and UI architecture skill that turns raw prose, technical specs, SQL schemas, fleet inventories, and smart-home entities into cohesive, responsive HTML interfaces across 17 structural archetypes.

- **Live 17-Tier Interactive Showcase:** https://FrankXLT.github.io/quiet-ui-skills/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/FrankXLT/quiet-ui-skills
- **Coverage:** 17 Tiers · 8 Navigation States · 3 Viewport Breakpoints (408 Verified Permutations)
- **License:** Apache 2.0 (Core Engine) + MIT (Customizations & UI Deliverables, 0 NOTICE obligations on shipped apps)

## 1. Installation & Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FrankXLT/quiet-ui-skills.git
cd quiet-ui-skills
./install.sh
```

Or copy `skills/visual-architecture-system/` into `~/.agents/skills/visual-architecture-system/` or `~/.gemini/config/skills/visual-architecture-system/`, and link `tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css`.

### Customize in 60 Seconds
To adapt Quiet UI to your brand or personal workspace, copy a starter from `customizations/`:
- **`customizations/personal-starter/`**: 17-tier blueprint for personal research, wellness pacing, and Home Assistant kiosks.
- **`customizations/brand-starter/`**: 13-tier blueprint for enterprise software products and documentation (omits ambient art and residential tiers).

Compile and verify via:
```bash
python3 customizations/scripts/build_showcase.py customizations/<target>
python3 customizations/scripts/verify_customization.py customizations/<target> --check-immutability
```

## 2. Core Architectural Rules

1. **Self-Immutability Lock & Gate 0 Customization Onboarding:**
   - Core skill files and starter blueprints (`skills/visual-architecture-system/`, `customizations/personal-starter/`, `customizations/brand-starter/`) are read-only and immutable.
   - User customizations live in dedicated folders (`customizations/<name>/`).
   - Gate 0 prompts for scope (Personal 17-tier vs. Brand 13-tier), clones the starter, extracts visual traits from 1–3 inspiration examples, compiles, and verifies.
2. **Pre-Edit Output Contract & Content-Only Preservation Lock:**
   - Declare `Execution Mode` (`Full Assembly` | `Content-Only`), `Target Tier & Nav`, `Surface & Density`, and `Verification Gate` before writing UI code.
   - **Content-Only Lock:** Preserve 100% of existing CSS and layout structure when updating copy, metrics, or rows on an existing page.
   - **Zero-Guidance Content Router:** Automatically maps raw user content to the optimal Tier (`01`..`17`), Navbar (`N0`..`N4`), and component blocks without asking boilerplate intake questions.
3. **Concentric Nested Border-Radius Math ($R_{\text{inner}} = \max(0, R_{\text{outer}} - \text{Inset})$):**
   - `--inset-pad: 4px;`
   - `--radius-inner: max(0px, calc(var(--radius-card, 8px) - var(--inset-pad, 4px)));`
   - `--radius-trough-pill: max(0px, calc(var(--radius-sm, 6px) - 2px));`
   - Evaluated dynamically across all 5 corner stops (`auto`, `sharp`, `subtle`, `rounded`, `soft`).
4. **Unified Suite Typography & Per-View Restraint:**
   - **3-Role Font Stack:** `--font-sans` (`Inter` + `tabular-nums`) for 100% of navigation (`13px` `--ts-nav`, `0px` drift), kickers (`11px` `--ts-xs`), UI controls, and `Doc-2`..`HA-3` headings (`--ts-xl: clamp(20px, 2vw, 24px)`); `--font-serif` (`Newsreader`) strictly for `Doc-1` narrative prose (`16.5px`) & display `H1` (`--ts-display: clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 28px)`); `--font-mono` (`JetBrains Mono`) strictly for machine literals.
   - **`11px` Hard Minimum Floor (`--ts-xs`):** Zero visible text `< 10.8px` anywhere in the DOM.
   - **Per-View Restraint:** Any single card budgets `<= 4` active font sizes and `2` primary contrast rungs (`--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`).
5. **6 Mathematical Alignment Invariants:**
   - **Invariant 1 (Straight Active Nav Pill):** Active nav/tree items use a straight `::before` vertical pill (`left: 4px; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 3px; border-radius: 99px`) instead of curved left borders.
   - **Invariant 2 (Zero Orphan Grid Hole):** `.va-bento-2col` enforces even card counts or `grid-column: 1 / -1` on trailing odd cards.
   - **Invariant 3 (Table Header Baseline):** `table.va-tree-grid th { vertical-align: top !important; }` keeps all `.va-th-title` spans aligned within `<= 2px`.
   - **Invariant 4 (Left Typographic Axis):** `.doc1-mobile-toc-bar` renders above `.doc1-kicker-text` so `|kicker.left - h1.left| <= 2px`.
   - **Invariant 5 (Bottom Dock Clearance):** Scrollable panes add `padding-bottom >= 64px` in `N4`.
   - **Invariant 6 (Zero Right-Edge Clipping):** `.va-tree-pane` stays a labeled `228px-260px` schema tree on `>= 641px`, and JSONB table cells truncate with `text-overflow: ellipsis`.

## 3. The 17-Tier Continuum (Default `data-theme="white"`)

- `01. Doc-1` — Academic & Scientific Monograph (`0%` Box Weight, `N1`)
- `02. Doc-2` — Executive Decision Memo (`BLUF` + Mermaid, `15%` Box Weight, `N0`)
- `03. Doc-3` — Normative RFC Specification (+ Mermaid FSM, `25%` Box Weight, `N0`)
- `04. Doc-4B` — Encyclopedic SDK & API Reference (`.va-flow-spine` + Decision Table, `25%` Box Weight, `N3`)
- `05. Doc-4A` — Split-Pane Operational Runbook (+ Mermaid Sequence, `45%` Box Weight, `N1`)
- `06. Bridge-1` — Parametric Engineering Worksheet (`50%` Box Weight, `N0`)
- `07. Deck-1` — Viewport-Locked Briefing Stage (`100dvh`, `60%` Box Weight, `N1`)
- `08. Bridge-2` — High-Density Data Table & Fleet Grid (`.va-fleet-card-3zone`, `.va-bulk-action-bar`, `100% 1px Grid`, `N2`)
- `09. App-2` — Live Metrics & Time-Series Console (`.va-prop-bar-row`, `.va-trajectory-chart`, `100% 1px Grid`, `N1`)
- `10. App-1` — Compact Issue & Ticket Tracker (`0% Cards / 36px Rows`, `N1`)
- `11. App-4` — Task & Calendar Planner (`.va-status-briefing`, `.va-priority-ring`, `.va-timegrid-block`, `80%`, `N1`)
- `12. App-3` — KPI & Analytics Dashboard (4-Layer Bento + 2x2 `.va-bento-2col`, `100% Cards`, `N2`)
- `13. App-5` — Daily Pacing & Wellness Planner (`.va-fill-capsule`, `.va-corridor-sparkline`, `.va-state-hypnogram`, `75%`, `N1`)
- `14. App-Tree` — Hierarchical Tree, Schema & File Explorer Workbench (`90% 3-Pane`, `N1`)
- `15. HA-1` — Ambient Wall Kiosk Screensaver (`.ha1-monet-stage` `65%` open Monet canvas + 3 floating `blur(24px) saturate(180%)` `.va-glass-panel` cards, `.va-glass-tile`, `.va-glass-slider`, `.va-glass-pill`, `.ha1-swatch-dot`, `20% HUD`, `N0`)
- `16. HA-2` — Room-First Wall Control Panel (`<= 4` metrics/room, `.va-prop-bar-row` circuit load, `85%`, `N1`)
- `17. HA-3` — Crease-Aware Foldable & Phone Controller (`56px` slider tiles, `820px` 50/50 split, `85%`, `N4`)

## 4. Reference Map

- [SKILL.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/SKILL.md): Core instructions, Output Contract, 17-Tier table, and progressive-disclosure router.
- [tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css](tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css): Standalone CSS Custom Properties (4 surface themes, 4 densities, concentric `--radius-inner`, `--ts-*` type scale, `.va-*` components, MIT licensed).
- [customizations/README.md](customizations/README.md): Starter kits (`personal-starter`, `brand-starter`), 60-second onboarding prompt, build & verification toolchain.
- [references/00-intake-questionnaire-and-project-lock.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/00-intake-questionnaire-and-project-lock.md): Pre-Edit Output Contract, Content-Only Lock, `.visual-lock.json`, and Zero-Guidance Content Router.
- [references/01-user-discovery-and-4-theme-tokens.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/01-user-discovery-and-4-theme-tokens.md): Surface Themes, Concentric 5-Stop Corner Radius Math, Color Policies, and 7-Step Typography Scale.
- [references/02-editorial-and-bridge-tiers.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/02-editorial-and-bridge-tiers.md): Tiers `01. Doc-1` through `06. Bridge-1` and theme-aware `.va-mermaid-figure`.
- [references/03-briefing-and-telemetry-tiers.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/03-briefing-and-telemetry-tiers.md): Tiers `07. Deck-1`, `08. Bridge-2` Fleet Grid, and `09. App-2` Time-Series Console.
- [references/04-application-workspace-tiers.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/04-application-workspace-tiers.md): Tiers `10. App-1`, `11. App-4`, `12. App-3`, `13. App-5`, and `14. App-Tree`.
- [references/05-family-d-home-assistant-and-5-resolutions.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/05-family-d-home-assistant-and-5-resolutions.md): Tiers `15. HA-1` through `17. HA-3` and 3-Breakpoint `@media` engine.
- [references/06-meta-chrome-and-nav-morphing.md](skills/visual-architecture-system/references/06-meta-chrome-and-nav-morphing.md): `N0-N4` Navigation Topologies, Font Awesome 6 taxonomy, `#va-floating-dock`, and `.va-oa-sidebar-footer`.
- [scripts/verify_visual_contract.py](skills/visual-architecture-system/scripts/verify_visual_contract.py): Static + `--check-docs` markdown snippet token & zero-placeholder verifier.
